description: We are Ceres Ventures, fintech entrepreneurs and blockchain specialists from Latin America with a deep passion for the space industry and advancing humanity. Big supporters of NASA's programs and open data, we built CERES: NASA field scores, rotation options and a voice assistant for farmers in Moquegua, Peru, with records anyone can verify. Our goal: help build the space economy, starting by putting satellite data to work for farmers. Team lead: Chris Garrido.
